description: Verified field catalog (83 entries): static tables code analysis + text-based semantic reverse-engineering + distribution analysis

fields.name: condition_start
fields.notes: Start index into EVTCONDBASE.

fields.name: condition_count
fields.notes: Number of EVTCONDBASE rows attached to the event.

fields.name: data_start
fields.notes: Start index into eventdata.dat records.

fields.name: command_count
fields.notes: Number of eventdata.dat records consumed by the event.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Event flags byte; bit 2 is checked when marking completion.

fields.name: opcode
fields.notes: Dispatches into the 78-case event opcode switch.

fields.name: arg0
fields.notes: Runtime argument byte 0; meaning depends on opcode.

fields.name: arg1
fields.notes: Runtime argument word 1; meaning depends on opcode.

fields.name: param
fields.notes: Runtime parameter dword.

fields.name: text_id
fields.notes: Memorytext id resolved into the runtime text pointer.

fields.name: flag_bit_0
fields.notes: Consulted inside the alternate pre-dispatch path entered when flag_bit_1 is set.

fields.name: flag_bit_1
fields.notes: Routes opcode handling through the alternate pre-dispatch path when EVT info bit0 is set.

fields.name: dice_slot_0
fields.notes: One of the six dice value slots consumed by STATUSDICE_Roll*.

fields.notes: One of the six dice value slots consumed by STATUSDICE_Roll*.

fields.name: mon_skill_start
fields.notes: Start index into MONSKILLBASE for monster AI skills.

fields.name: mon_skill_count
fields.notes: Number of MONSKILLBASE rows linked from the monster record.

fields.name: monster_u8_0x24
fields.notes: Consumed directly from MONDATABASE+0x24.

fields.name: action_id
fields.notes: Action/skill id copied into the learned monster skill entry.

fields.name: unit_start
fields.notes: Start index into BUFFUNITBASE.

fields.name: unit_count
fields.notes: Number of BUFFUNITBASE rows referenced by the buff.

fields.name: target_kind
fields.notes: Filter byte checked before applying the buff-unit effect.

fields.name: target_attr_id
fields.notes: Attribute id matched against the requested attribute update.

fields.name: operation
fields.notes: Operation selector forwarded into UTIL_Calculate.

fields.name: formula_text_id_e
fields.notes: Expression text id resolved through MEMORYTEXT_GetText_E.

fields.name: name_text_id
fields.notes: Primary skill/action name text id.

fields.name: action_kind
fields.notes: Read before AI-specific action filtering.

fields.name: flags
fields.notes: Bit 2 is checked while composing the skill description UI.

fields.name: act_unit_count
fields.notes: Loop count forwarded to ACTDATA_GetActUnit.

fields.name: desc_style
fields.notes: Signed style byte used while assembling description text.

fields.name: reward_start
fields.notes: Start index into QUESTREWARDBASE.

fields.name: reward_count
fields.notes: Number of QUESTREWARDBASE rows linked to the quest.

fields.name: item_id
fields.notes: Item id awarded by the reward entry.

fields.name: quantity
fields.notes: Item quantity awarded by the reward entry.

fields.name: class_mask
fields.notes: Bit mask checked against the main player's class before granting the reward.

fields.name: map_index
fields.notes: Index into MAPINFOBASE (126/159 unique values within 0–415). Monsters sharing the same map index spawn on that map.

fields.name: monster_type_text
fields.notes: Text id for monster behavioural archetype (11 unique values, TEXT 100%). 5 values overlap with CHARCLASSBASE skill texts.

fields.name: drop_item_text
fields.notes: Text id of common drop item (401/553 records match ITEMDATABASE name text IDs; 176/203 unique values).

fields.name: spawn_zone_text
fields.notes: Text id describing spawn zone or region name (TEXT 86%, 109 unique).

fields.name: item_subcategory_text
fields.notes: Sub-category descriptor text id (TEXT 70%, 101 unique; some high values yield empty text).

fields.name: item_effect_desc
fields.notes: Short effect/description text id (TEXT 90%, 68 unique).

fields.name: required_class_desc
fields.notes: Text id of class required for quest (TEXT 65%, 24 unique; value 0=any class, 1–5=specific class descriptions).

fields.name: quest_info_text
fields.notes: Additional quest information text id (TEXT 69%, 11 unique; reward/item reference hints).

fields.name: map_subtitle_text
fields.notes: Map subtitle or category description text id (TEXT 85%, 50 unique).

fields.name: map_flags_text
fields.notes: Map flags indicator (TEXT 100%, only 2 unique: 255 for 415 maps, 0 for 1 map). Likely a visibility/town-safe flag.

fields.name: class_display_name
fields.notes: Displayed class name text id (TEXT 83%, 6 unique matching 6 classes).

fields.name: base_skill_text
fields.notes: Default base skill name text id (TEXT 100%, 6 unique; each class has one base skill).

fields.name: starter_equip_text
fields.notes: Starting equipment name text id (TEXT 100%, 6 unique).

fields.name: starter_item_text
fields.notes: Starting item description text id (TEXT 100%, 6 unique).

fields.name: mercenary_attr_text
fields.notes: Mercenary attribute/trait text id (TEXT 100%, 41 unique for 47 mercenaries).

fields.name: mercenary_name
fields.notes: Mercenary display name text id (TEXT 100%, 47 unique; names like 黑暗骑士, 忍者, 暗影猎手).

fields.name: npc_role_text
fields.notes: NPC role or title text id (TEXT 81%, 17 unique; e.g. merchant, quest-giver subtype).

fields.name: drop_item_text
fields.notes: Drop item name text id (TEXT 100%, 35 unique; items like 金指环, 教团勇士徽章).

fields.name: drop_desc_text
fields.notes: Drop description text id (TEXT 100%, 109 unique; item descriptions and effect texts).

fields.name: item_desc_ref
fields.notes: Reference text id for item description lookup (TEXT 98%, 152 unique; e.g. class desc texts).

fields.name: item_name_text
fields.notes: Item display name text id (TEXT 100%, 152 unique; bag size names like 4格背包, 8格背包, 12格背包).

fields.name: enchant_attr_text
fields.notes: Enchant attribute name text id (TEXT 100%, 12 unique; stat names like 敏捷, 体力).

fields.name: enchant_suffix_text
fields.notes: Enchant suffix/name text id applied to enchanted items (TEXT 100%, 16 unique; names like 黑暗骑士, 守护石魔).

fields.name: grade_name_prefix
fields.notes: 品质名称前缀 TEXT 60% 15唯一(生锈的/锋利的等)

fields.name: grade_name_suffix
fields.notes: 品质名称后缀 TEXT 60% 15唯一(与+0成对)

fields.name: grade_item_ref
fields.notes: 关联物品名 TEXT 60% 13唯一(基础戒指等)

fields.name: grade_scale
fields.notes: 品质缩放系数 ENUM 0-3 15条分布(1占6/3占5)

fields.name: rarity_name
fields.notes: 稀有度名 TEXT 100% 4唯一

fields.name: static_id
fields.notes: 静态类型ID TEXT 100% 4唯一(1-4)

fields.name: static_slot_count
fields.notes: 对应槽位数 TEXT 100% 4唯一(4/8/16 背包容量系)

fields.name: class_name
fields.notes: 类别名 TEXT 100% 36唯一(短剑/剑/斧等)

fields.name: class_type_ref
fields.notes: 类别类型引用 TEXT 100% 8唯一(512等位域)

fields.name: class_desc
fields.notes: 类别描述 TEXT 94% 36唯一(短刃剑等)

fields.name: class_stat_ref
fields.notes: 关联属性名 TEXT 100% 7唯一(敏捷等 主属性)

fields.name: class_icon_ref
fields.notes: 图标/显示名 TEXT 100% 36唯一(复活卷轴等)
